title: Identity-law follow-up and narrowed source gaps
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full actual follow-up review; conditional source resolution, historical access limits and unchanged proposed defaults
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full243-line follow-up read. IG1–IG3, all19-world entries,25 narrowed/resolved route rows across9 worlds, the10 unchanged entries, source-route limits and default-delta table are actually reviewed. This is an attributed local synthesis, not new raw-book/payload verification. SHOWN retains dossier attribution; wiki read_complete, character counts, file indexes and hashes do not prove meaning. The original171-row matrix's UNKNOWN cells must be read with this later route-specific follow-up, rather than treated as19 newly completed world laws.

F2: Keep HP fragmentation, diary occupation, shade anchoring, stated remorse reintegration, ghost imprint and fragment coexistence separate. Their six rows narrow specific old gaps without proving equal soul fractions, arbitrary safe merger, complete mind printing, temporal coexistence or universal authentication. Polyjuice appearance does not transfer memory/personhood. Preserve count-term ambiguity and book/film differences. Bleach artificial occupancy displaces a continuing actor; Mod-Soul creation differs from copying an existing mind; Gigai differs from person, and Utsusemi afterimage differs from conscious copy. Their five rows leave exact compatibility, cycle and higher exceptions open.

F3: LM1–LM6 preserve distributed avatar production, actual plurality, shallow/deep parasite knowledge, marionette resource/controller ownership and historical projection consciousness as distinct route contracts. Returned later notes/advisory corrections are not parent-finalized source qualification; exact serial1173 correction matters, with parent r038 limit reported only at that historical inspection. Do not treat that cutoff as freshly verified current status or adopt later quantified restrictions as universal canon here. COI does not backport sequel behavior into early Klein. Loss of one instance is not automatic total extinction; controlled thoughtlessness does not prove every former soul destroyed. Stronger source means and exact later exceptions remain possible, without unlimited assumed duplication.

F4: Roshar has no newly resolved cells in this follow-up. Scadrial CM1 substrate fragmentation/access keying does not establish a whole autonomous mind, and metallic-arts evidence does not settle Roshar return law. ER1 supports a particular spirit/vessel survival case; zero-character/unread Mimic/Rebirth entries cannot settle their named operations. JK1–JK3 distinguish technique clones, replicated soul information, self-aware cores and remote puppets. ML1 is a stated Soul Meld method, with early loop explanation still conjecture. RP1 distinguishes bodily defeat, surviving soul and final extinction. FR1's targeted mana comparison/control is not person equality. These retain useful source-specific examples without forcing all into the same soul/copy model.

F5: Naruto, FMA, Chainsaw Man, Fallout, Skyrim and D&D preserve their exact unresolved scope rather than new unsupported law. Named spells/pages are retrieval leads, not claimed mechanisms; mixed editions, games, DLC, eras and continuities stay separated. Missing cache claims and unavailable dump routes describe the historical inspection, not a live external blocker or authorization to reacquire. Frontier/Proto23 authored ordinary scope and Proving Ground representation do not prove uniqueness or conscious-person generation. Unresolved canon may be retained as a labelled original proposal where chosen, without representing it as source evidence.

F6: None/Implied/Present/Playable, IX prior-played-character setting, BW fresh/continued branch and actual native identity mechanisms are independent axes. All delta-table world defaults here remain proposals; source-informed optional encounters do not change them automatically. Current developer-route priority supersedes old ordinary-first sequencing. No world queue or paused game is reactivated. Reuse actual actor/body/controller/knowledge/custody owners and first useful seams under AD51; do not add a parallel universal identity ledger. Sealed former-host/identity truth remains outside public offer details. This reconciliation changes documentation only, with no source acquisition, private-save access, gameplay, new fields, migration, native UI or commits.
reviews.evidence: Full243-line current follow-up read in three untruncated bounded chunks; matrix full review B545 supplies immediate comparison. No underlying source requalification.
reviews.reopen: Reopen exact chosen operation when its source, controller/former-occupant, continuity or evidence version changes.
